admission.justification: Enforced in role_retire.py (_require_no_open_children) and guarded by explicit open-child refusal and successor-Manager retirement tests.

applicability: Explicit retire_child calls targeting a role seat that has started child role seats.
conditions: Evaluate child receipts by launch parent identity, recorded retirement status, and live host state before archiving the parent.
Refuse with every open child seat named until those children retire; replacement instead preserves surviving children for the successor.
exclusions: Replacing starts via role_start, which preserve surviving children for the successor Manager or Orchestrator.

evidence: W2 expanded evidence E7 and the existing turn_ended.test.ts archived/missing-parent cases.

statement: Explicit retirement refuses with every open child seat named, and a successor Manager can retire a surviving child of its predecessor within its master.
title: Explicit retirement refuses while any child seat remains open
